qa_report.summary: A clean A2 micro-dialogue. All three lines are grammatically correct and natural: 'I've just moved out of my old house' and 'I've already paid the rent' model the grammar point (present perfect with just/already) accurately, and 'How many rooms does the new flat have?' is a natural, level-appropriate question recycling the review word 'room' (with 'house' also recycled in line 1). The target word 'rent' is used in context and its gloss ('the money you pay every month to live in a flat or house') is accurate and simpler than the word itself. The grammar note explains 'just' (a very short time ago) and 'already' (before now, often sooner than expected) correctly in learner-friendly language. No vocabulary exceeds A2 apart from the intended target word. The interaction prompt appropriately elicits the target structure. Nothing to fix.
